Integration jobs must use `ci-runner-arm64`; avoid the retired `ci-runner-small` pool.

## Recent work: Worker memory retention was fixed by removing `BillingWorker._last_batch`; all 41 worker tests passed, and a 5,000-batch reproduction showed 7.3 MiB peak, 2.1 MiB retained, and 0 pending events. The full suite passed: `118 passed, 7 skipped, 0 failed in 8.74s`. CLI billing filters were consolidated with `_add_billing_filters()` and explicit `dest="currency"`. Exact relevant test results were `15 passed` for `tests/test_cli.py` and `22 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped` for `tests/test_commands.py`. Invoice-list help now has only one `--currency/-c` option. The US rc.3 canary deployment rolled out successfully. Stripe signature verification still needs diagnosis and a fix; review the current diff and rerun focused tests before committing.

## Current objective: Add pagination to `GET /v1/invoices` in `ledgerly/api/invoices.py`. In parallel, continue the “Kubernetes Three-Region Staged Rollout” procedure in order; steps 1–3 are complete and step 4 is next. Do not disable idempotency middleware—it caused duplicate invoices. All sandbox third-party credentials must use the `ledgerly_sbx` prefix and be configured through `settings/vendor_sbx.toml`, not environment variables.

## Recent work: Scheduler DST handling was patched and covered by focused midnight and New York transition tests. Scheduler, billing, and currency-rounding suites passed; `ruff` and `git diff --check` were clean. The full suite had one unrelated legacy invoice-rounding failure (`expected 1000, got 1001`); it was left unchanged. Added `tests/test_currency_rounding.py`; all 6 tests pass with 91% coverage of `billing/currency.py`.

For the rollout, US health passed, image `registry.acme.io/payments-api:2.8.0-rc.3` was built/pushed, and schema-migration job `api-2-8-0-schema` was created in `prod-us-east-1`. Next run the ordered wait command for that job, then create the US canary using rc.2 (2 replicas), update it to rc.3, and wait for rollout before promoting EU and APAC. Invoice pagination has not yet been implemented.
